record.reason: Retain HOLD. This is not safely dismissible as a biological metaphor: the actual mathematical object is a waning-immunity infection process, with serious epidemiological motivation. Conversely, the stated target is general information/diffusion survival and the same mechanisms intentionally cover social adoption. Focused body review does not establish that medical/biomedical research, rather than multi-domain diffusion theory, is primary. Theoretical-only work and absence of wet-lab or disease-specific data are not exclusion grounds.

record.title: INT: Instance-Specific Negative Mining for Task-Generic Promptable Segmentation
record.reason: Retain HOLD rather than include on a false MIS-ablation claim or exclude merely because the method is generic. The medical evaluation is too substantive to call a token medical example, but the motivating and diagnostic empirical work centers on camouflage and general prompt generation. The paper does not decisively establish medical segmentation as a primary research direction rather than a substantial secondary transfer demonstration.

record.title: An End-to-End Simple Clustering Hierarchical Pooling Operation for Graph Learning Based on Top-K Node Selection
record.reason: Recommend EXCLUDE. The complete empirical narrative validates graph pooling across structural regimes; biochemical datasets are substantial benchmark support but do not define a primary biomedical investigation. This is not exclusion for generic architecture or absence of wet-lab results: the actual objectives, dataset-selection rationale and interpretations are graph-computational throughout, with a coequal social-graph program.

record.title: EnergyCompress: A General Case Base Learning Strategy
record.reason: Recommend EXCLUDE. Medical cases serve as members of a heterogeneous benchmark pool for a case-base maintenance claim. The actual research program concerns decision boundaries, generic competence measures, algorithm-tailored selection and compression, not medical prediction as a primary application. The number of medical datasets is not used as a decision rule.

record.title: Dirichlet Process-Based Robust Clustering Using the Median-of-Means Estimator
record.reason: Recommend EXCLUDE. The cancer-expression panel is substantial and must be acknowledged, but its actual function is generic real-data validation after geometric/noise tests. The full emphasis remains robustness, automatic cluster count and statistical algorithm ranking, not a primary biomedical analysis. This is not rejection because the method is generic or because biological discoveries/wet-lab experiments are absent.

record.title: Long-Term Individual Causal Effect Estimation via Identifiable Latent Representation Learning
record.reason: Recommend EXCLUDE. The use of biomedical-source covariates does not establish a biomedical causal question: the actual treatments/outcomes are generic generated variables and the study validates identifiability/estimation theory. This is not an exclusion merely for simulation; a medically specified simulated intervention could qualify, but that is not the main-paper research described here.

record.title: SpectralGap: Graph-Level Out-of-Distribution Detection via Laplacian Eigenvalue Gaps
record.reason: Retain HOLD. The concentration and depth of biochemical evaluations make a simple incidental-benchmark exclusion unsafe; the generic architecture is not disqualifying. At the same time, the actual question is cross-dataset graph OOD detection with interchangeable domain pairs, and the paper does not establish a biomedical-specific primary objective. Do not include solely by the number of molecular pairs or claim all ablations are biological.

record.title: RetroMoE: A Mixture-of-Experts Latent Translation Framework for Single-step Retrosynthesis
record.reason: Recommend EXCLUDE from a biomedical-primary census. This is genuine molecular reaction-chemistry research, not merely an incidental chemistry benchmark, but its actual scientific target is general synthesis prediction. Pharmaceutical usefulness in the introduction does not by itself establish biomedical-primary work. Exclusion is not for lack of disease or wet-lab experiments, and does not exclude non-disease proteins/genes/cells.

record.title: Electron Density-enhanced Molecular Geometry Learning
record.reason: Recommend EXCLUDE. The primary actual research is general quantum chemistry and force-field representation, with efficiency and energy/force fidelity as endpoints. Biomedical usefulness is prospective and drug/biomolecule names appear as general molecular-physics test systems. This is not exclusion for lacking disease labels or wet-lab validation: non-disease biological mechanisms and biomolecules are eligible when biological research is the actual focus.
